summary.request: Purchase orders need a Supplier Contract Reference typed by the buyer. It must be visible on posted purchase invoices and on vendor ledger entries. When a purchase invoice is posted, the reference and the invoice number must be sent to the supplier's web portal.
summary.business-process: Purchase document posting (Purch.-Post creating posted purchase headers by TransferFields and vendor ledger entries through Gen. Journal Line), with follow-up integration after posting

lifecycle.step: Set an explicit DataClassification on every new field and table; resolve every ToBeClassified before release.

Register a custom Privacy Notice for the supplier portal (CreatePrivacyNotice during setup or OnRegisterPrivacyNotices). The background sender checks GetPrivacyNoticeApprovalState and does not send without approval.
Singleton Supplier Portal Setup with a card page; validate the stored portal URL with Uri.AreURIsHaveSameHost or Uri.IsValidURIPattern against a fixed expected value before each call.
Store portal credentials only in IsolatedStorage (SetEncrypted when it fits) and carry them as SecretText; prefer OAuth2 via the OAuth2 codeunit if the portal supports it.

Run Supplier Portal Sender as a recurring job queue entry: non-interactive, errors propagate to the job queue log, external call idempotent through the outbox SystemId, outbox row deleted only after the call and local updates succeed.
Ship a permission set listing each new table (tabledata), page and codeunit explicitly, with no wildcard grants.

knowledge.used-for: Path map for a header field through document posting; purchases follow the same map
constraints: Plan one step per stage the field must reach.
Copy Document copies posted and archived headers back with TransferFields; decide whether the value should flow back.

knowledge.used-for: Mirroring the field on posted purchase headers and the archive
constraints: Same field number, name, type and length on Purchase Header and every target: all four posted headers and Purchase Header Archive unless the plan states a document type never needs it.
No subscriber for TransferFields stages.
Mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables.

knowledge.used-for: Carrying the field to Vendor Ledger Entry
constraints: Add the field to Gen. Journal Line and Vendor Ledger Entry and subscribe to OnAfterCopyGenJnlLineFromPurchHeader and OnAfterCopyVendLedgerEntryFromGenJnlLine.
Do not find and Modify the vendor entry from OnAfterPostPurchaseDoc.

knowledge.used-for: Preview guard and outbox insertion in the purchase after-posting subscriber
constraints: OnAfterPostPurchaseDoc has no PreviewMode parameter; detect preview with "Gen. Jnl.-Post Preview".IsActive() and exit before any external side effect.
CommitIsSupressed is not a preview substitute.
Do not call Commit(), do not rely on rollback, hand external calls to an outbox processed by a recurring job queue entry.
Confirm the event's parameters in the target version's symbols.

knowledge.used-for: General rules for after-posting follow-up processing
constraints: Subscriber errors do not undo posting.
No Commit() in the subscriber; outbox row plus recurring job queue entry for external calls; use the posted document number passed by the event.

knowledge.used-for: Type and length agreement across the mirrored cascade
constraints: Define the mirrored field with the exact same number, type and length on every table in the cascade.

knowledge.used-for: Ruling out patching posted vendor ledger entries
constraints: Do not persist changes to posted ledger content outside supported workflows; fill the extension field during posting instead.

knowledge.used-for: Deferring the portal call out of the posting transaction
constraints: No HttpClient after a write in the same transaction; insert an outbox row in the same transaction and process committed rows from a recurring job queue entry; delete after HTTP completes.
Do not use Commit() as a remedy.

knowledge.used-for: Retry safety of the portal call
constraints: Send a stable request ID (outbox SystemId) the portal must enforce as unique.
Delete the outbox row only after the call and local updates succeed; a Processed flag does not close the failure window.

knowledge.used-for: Failure reporting from the sender job
constraints: Let errors that invalidate the run propagate; do not swallow TryFunction or Boolean failures.

knowledge.used-for: Background-safe sender
constraints: No Confirm, RunModal, Message-as-result or other UI in the job queue handler.

knowledge.used-for: Handling portal responses
constraints: Check IsSuccessStatusCode() before treating the body as success; handle non-success explicitly.

knowledge.used-for: Handling transport failures
constraints: When the Boolean result is captured and false, do not read the response; omitting the Boolean for fail-fast is valid.

knowledge.used-for: Carrying portal credentials
constraints: Credentials as SecretText end to end; never round-trip through Text.

knowledge.used-for: Storing portal credentials
constraints: Credentials in IsolatedStorage, never a table field; prefer SetEncrypted.

knowledge.used-for: Authentication choice for the portal
constraints: When the partner supports OAuth, use the OAuth2 codeunit rather than API keys or basic auth.

knowledge.used-for: Validating the stored portal URL
constraints: Before any HttpClient call to a URL from a table field, validate it with Uri.AreURIsHaveSameHost or Uri.IsValidURIPattern against a fixed value and Error on mismatch.

knowledge.used-for: Consent before sending data to the supplier portal
constraints: Register a custom notice ID; no path sends without approval; use GetPrivacyNoticeApprovalState where no UI may be shown.

knowledge.used-for: Data classification of new fields and tables
constraints: Resolve every ToBeClassified to a real classification before release.

knowledge.used-for: Tooltips on the new page fields
constraints: Page fields need an explicit or inherited non-empty tooltip; on runtime 13.0 (BC24) or later define it on the table field; applies from BC24 for inheritance, otherwise page-level.

knowledge.used-for: Test fixtures
constraints: Build vendors, items and purchase documents with the Library codeunits, parents first.

knowledge.used-for: Portal setup table
constraints: Singleton setup: Code[10] blank Primary Key, card page with InsertAllowed/DeleteAllowed false and open-time insert.

knowledge.used-for: Permission set membership for new objects
constraints: Every exposed object needs an explicit execute entry in a shipped permission set.

knowledge.used-for: Permission set granularity
constraints: Enumerate each tabledata and object explicitly; no wildcard grants; grant only needed letters.

open-questions.question: Should Supplier Contract Reference be Code or Text, and what maximum length? The same type and length will be used on every mirrored table.

Is the reference needed on receipts, return orders/credit memos, return shipments and archives? The mirroring article requires them unless you state a document type never needs it; the design currently includes all of them.
Should buyers also type the reference on purchase invoices (and credit memos) entered directly, not only on purchase orders? Only the Purchase Order page is extended now.

When a user copies a posted or archived purchase document, should the reference flow back into the new document? If not, a clearing subscriber is needed; no purchase Copy Document event was confirmed in BCQuality knowledge.
Should posting a purchase credit memo also notify the portal, or only purchase invoices?
Is the reference mandatory before posting, and should an invoice with a blank reference still be sent to the portal?
Is there one supplier portal for all vendors or a different portal (URL, credentials) per vendor? This decides whether the setup is a singleton or per-vendor configuration.
What is the portal's endpoint, payload format and authentication method (OAuth2 supported?), and does it accept an idempotency key and treat repeats as the same request?
Which fixed host or URL pattern should the stored portal URL be validated against?
How often should the sender job run, and who creates the recurring job queue entry (setup action, install code, or manual)?
How should persistent send failures be surfaced to users beyond the job queue log?
